name: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi
short_description: A 358-room colonial-era icon open since 1901, blending the historic Heritage Wing with the newer Opera Wing near Hoan Kiem Lake, awarded a MICHELIN Key in 2025.
ai_summary: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi has operated continuously since 1901, making it one of Southeast Asia's most storied hotels, with the original Heritage Wing preserving colonial-era grandeur alongside the neo-classical Opera Wing added later. The 358-room property sits close to Hoan Kiem Lake in central Hanoi, and its historian-led tours of the hotel's bomb shelter and wartime history are a signature experience. In October 2025 the hotel received a MICHELIN Key in the inaugural MICHELIN Guide Vietnam edition, and Fodor's named it among the 100 Most Incredible Hotels in the World for 2026, alongside a 2025 Travel + Leisure Luxury Awards Asia Pacific win. Guests consistently praise the elegant blend of French colonial and modern luxury, acclaimed dining, and outstanding service, with the main caveat being premium pricing relative to Hanoi's other five-star hotels.

faqs.question: How old is Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi?
faqs.answer: It has operated continuously since 1901, making it one of Southeast Asia's most storied hotels -- the original Heritage Wing preserves colonial-era grandeur alongside the later, neo-classical Opera Wing.

faqs.question: Has Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi won any recent awards?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it received a MICHELIN Key in the inaugural MICHELIN Guide Vietnam edition (October 2025), was named a leading city hotel in the 2025 Travel + Leisure Luxury Awards Asia Pacific, and appeared on Fodor's 100 Most Incredible Hotels in the World for 2026.
